phase_1.title: Phase 1 · MAC-10 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the .45 ACP (11.43×23mm) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 145 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 145 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 146 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 6-groove bore and accelerates to 280 m/s (585 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Open-Bolt Slam & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 30-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the MAC-10 staged for its 1,090 RPM (Full-Auto / Semi) cadence.

zh.headline: 英格拉姆 MAC-10 .45 ACP 微型冲锋枪：1970 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 戈登·英格拉姆设计的 MAC-10 采用极简冲压方盒钢机匣与包络式开膛枪机，射速高达 1,090 发/分；其原生配套米切尔·韦贝尔设计的双级 Sionics 消音器不仅可将 .45 ACP 枪声大幅衰减，更充当双手控枪的前握把。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：MAC-10 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1970 年问世的 英格拉姆 MAC-10 .45 ACP 微型冲锋枪 由美国军事装备公司（MAC）主导研制，定位为经典的超紧凑高射速冲锋手枪。MAC-10 诞生于 1970 年并随消音套件进入越战后期特种侦察任务，其冷峻的方形工业剪影成为冷战后期近战微冲的标志符号。
戈登·英格拉姆设计的 MAC-10 采用极简冲压方盒钢机匣与包络式开膛枪机，射速高达 1,090 发/分；其原生配套米切尔·韦贝尔设计的双级 Sionics 消音器不仅可将 .45 ACP 枪声大幅衰减，更充当双手控枪的前握把。 整件装备总长 548 mm（收缩托 269 mm，不含消音器）、空重 2.84 kg，成为同期冲锋枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1970 年，美国军事装备公司（MAC）推出了划时代的英格拉姆 MAC-10 .45 ACP 微型冲锋枪。MAC-10 诞生于 1970 年并随消音套件进入越战后期特种侦察任务，其冷峻的方形工业剪影成为冷战后期近战微冲的标志符号。 它的核心设计聚焦于269 mm 极致手枪尺寸封装 30 发 .45 ACP 火力与 1,090 RPM 爆发射速，奠定了其在冲锋枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 英格拉姆 MAC-10 .45 ACP 微型冲锋枪 的机械灵魂在于其「自由枪机 · 开膛包络式枪机 + 双级粗螺纹消音器」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，重型枪机自后方阻铁释放前冲完成推弹、闭膛与惯性击发循环，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用磷酸锰军规磷化钢精加工而成。双级 Sionics 大容积消音器同时兼具降噪、减跳与辅助前握持三重职能，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。英格拉姆 MAC-10 .45 ACP 微型冲锋枪 采用自由枪机 · 开膛包络式枪机 + 双级粗螺纹消音器。在每个击发周期中，重型枪机自后方阻铁释放前冲完成推弹、闭膛与惯性击发循环。借助磷酸锰军规磷化钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了双级 Sionics 大容积消音器同时兼具降噪、减跳与辅助前握持三重职能。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 .45 ACP (11.43×23mm) 弹药规格与 146 mm · 6 条右旋膛线（1:406 mm）+ 粗螺距消音器接口，最高工作膛压约 145 MPa，可赋予弹头 280 m/s 的出膛初速与 585 J 动能，有效作用距离达 70 米。
内膛技术特点方面，短枪管配合粗螺距膛口直接旋接 Sionics 双级大容量消音器兼作前握把。同时，全钢板冲压折弯焊接结构极易量产，顶部旋转拉机柄可转 90° 锁定枪机作保险，令其在 1,090 发/分（全自动 / 半自动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 146 毫米身管与 .45 ACP (11.43×23mm) 口径，英格拉姆 MAC-10 .45 ACP 微型冲锋枪 实现了每秒 280 米的初速与 70 米有效射程。短枪管配合粗螺距膛口直接旋接 Sionics 双级大容量消音器兼作前握把，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 45 mm 膛轴设计，英格拉姆 MAC-10 .45 ACP 微型冲锋枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 5.5 N·s 水平。伸缩式钢丝抵肩托配合前帆布拉带抑制高射速连发时的枪口上扬。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-62）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，伸缩式钢丝抵肩托配合前帆布拉带抑制高射速连发时的枪口上扬。欢迎在 BAY-62 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 英格拉姆 MAC-10 .45 ACP 微型冲锋枪 的机械魅力。

en.headline: Ingram MAC-10: The 1970 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Designed by Gordon Ingram with a stark stamped-steel box receiver and telescoping open bolt, the MAC-10 cycles .45 ACP at 1,090 RPM and was conceived from day one to pair with Mitchell WerBell’s two-stage Sionics suppressor as a front grip. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-62.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the MAC-10
paragraphs: Introduced in 1970 by Military Armament Corporation (MAC) in United States, the Ingram MAC-10 emerged as a defining Compact Open-Bolt Machine Pistol. Unveiled in 1970 with its iconic two-stage suppressor, the MAC-10 saw limited Vietnam-era clandestine trials and defined the silhouette of late-Cold War machine pistols.

Designed by Gordon Ingram with a stark stamped-steel box receiver and telescoping open bolt, the MAC-10 cycles .45 ACP at 1,090 RPM and was conceived from day one to pair with Mitchell WerBell’s two-stage Sionics suppressor as a front grip. Measuring 548 mm (269 mm Stock Collapsed, Excl. Suppressor) at an unloaded weight of 2.84 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Submachine Gun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1970, Military Armament Corporation (MAC) of United States introduced the Ingram MAC-10. Unveiled in 1970 with its iconic two-stage suppressor, the MAC-10 saw limited Vietnam-era clandestine trials and defined the silhouette of late-Cold War machine pistols. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — 269 mm collapsed length packs 30 rounds of .45 ACP at a blistering 1,090 RPM — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Ingram MAC-10 sits its Simple Blowback · Open-Bolt Telescoping Bolt Paired with Two-Stage Sionics Suppressor. Throughout every firing cycle, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia, containing 145 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Purpose-built two-stage Sionics suppressor doubles as a recoil-taming forward handhold, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Ingram MAC-10 relies on Simple Blowback · Open-Bolt Telescoping Bolt Paired with Two-Stage Sionics Suppressor. During each cycle, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia. Machined from manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Purpose-built two-stage Sionics suppressor doubles as a recoil-taming forward handhold.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for .45 ACP (11.43×23mm) with 146 mm · 6-Groove RH Rifling (1:406 mm) with Coarse Suppressor Threads, the Ingram MAC-10 develops 280 m/s muzzle velocity and 585 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 70 meters.

Internally, Short 146 mm barrel carries coarse muzzle threads engineered to mount a two-stage Sionics suppressor as a forward grip. Combined with its 1,090 RPM (Full-Auto / Semi) tempo, Boxy stamped-steel construction includes a rotating top charging knob acting as a bolt lock, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving .45 ACP (11.43×23mm) through its 146 millimeter bore, the Ingram MAC-10 achieves 280 meters per second and 70 meters of effective reach. Short 146 mm barrel carries coarse muzzle threads engineered to mount a two-stage Sionics suppressor as a forward grip.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 30-round 30-round detachable magazine body with a 45 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 5.5 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Collapsing wire stock and front strap help anchor rapid close-quarters bursts.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-62), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 30-round 30-round detachable magazine body with disciplined recoil geometry, Collapsing wire stock and front strap help anchor rapid close-quarters bursts. Explore BAY-62 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Ingram MAC-10.
